correctness.rationale: The expected payoff difference is B times the pivotal probability minus cost. Exact binomial enumeration yields \(H_p(x)=px+3(1-p)x(1-x)^2\). Its derivative has two internal zeros precisely for \(0<p<1/2\), giving necessary and sufficient strict inequalities for exactly three interior roots. The vector-field sign sequence gives attractors 0, middle root, and 1; no mixture with maximum group size at most three can provide three interior roots; no deterministic size can do so. Exact rational witness factors into \((2x-1)(3x-2)(6x-5)/23\). The embedded reproducibility script passed 4795 checks, including 500 numerical parameter stress tests, which are not used to prove the universal statements.

value.rationale: The sharp threshold identifies the smallest possible ecological/social interaction group-size heterogeneity that creates three simultaneously stable cooperation outcomes under two-helper production. The result changes the qualitative phase portrait beyond fixed-size and negative-binomial examples; an open parameter region and exact rational witness rule out isolated fine-tuning. This is a meaningful structural boundary for evolutionary collective action without introducing extra player strategies, selective assortment, external rewards or empirical claims.
